product: BEARPAW Men's Moc II Multiple Colors | Men's Slipper | Men's Shoe | Comfortable & Lightweight
description_en: A tan-brown moccasin-style slipper has a suede-like upper, brown laces, and a pale fluffy lining visible around the opening. Its thick brown rubber sole has a low heel and a textured edge.
description_zh: 这是一只棕褐色莫卡辛风格的拖鞋，鞋面呈麂皮质感，配有棕色鞋带，鞋口露出浅色绒毛内衬。厚实的棕色橡胶鞋底带有低跟和纹理边缘。

product: Clarks Men's Escalade Step
description_en: A black slip-on dress shoe with a smooth, shiny leather-like upper and a short stitched panel on the vamp. It has a low black rubber sole with a small raised heel and textured sides.
description_zh: 这是一双黑色套脚正装鞋，鞋面看起来光滑亮面，类似皮革，鞋背有一小块缝线饰片。黑色橡胶鞋底较低，带有小块凸起的鞋跟和纹理侧边。

product: EYUSHIJIA Men's Waterproof Snow Boots Hiking Boot
description_en: A taupe-brown ankle-high hiking boot has a smooth, suede-like upper, darker brown padded collar, and tan accent panels. It fastens with brown laces through metal eyelets, above a thick cream-colored lugged sole with a tan strip along the edge.
description_zh: 这是一只灰褐色的高帮徒步靴，鞋面看起来光滑、像绒面革，配有深棕色软垫鞋口和棕黄色拼接饰片。棕色鞋带穿过金属鞋眼系紧，下方是厚实的奶油色齿纹鞋底，边缘带有棕黄色条纹。

product: DADAWEN Women's Classic T-Strap Platform Mid-Heel Square Toe Oxfords Dress Shoes
description_en: A black, glossy T-strap Oxford-style shoe has a square toe and a smooth-looking upper with perforated trim. It fastens with a buckle at the side, and has a thick, ridged platform sole with a chunky block heel.
description_zh: 这是一只黑色亮面 T 字带牛津风鞋，方头，鞋面看起来光滑，并饰有穿孔边饰。鞋侧以搭扣固定，配有厚实的凹槽防滑厚底和粗跟。

product: KEEN Women's Newport H2 Sandal
description_en: A black closed-toe sandal with a textured rubber toe guard and wide webbing straps over the upper. It fastens with elastic laces and a cord lock; the thick black sole has deep tread and a raised toe guard.
description_zh: 这是一款黑色包头凉鞋，鞋头有纹理橡胶护边，鞋面覆有宽织带。它以弹力鞋带和锁扣固定；厚实的黑色鞋底带有较深的纹路，鞋头向上包覆。

product: Vionic Women's, Shore Slide Sandal
description_en: A tan slide sandal has two wide, textured cork-like straps with small shiny gold-toned flecks. It slips on with no visible fastening, and has a tan footbed above a dark brown, slightly raised sole.
description_zh: 这是一款棕褐色一字拖凉鞋，鞋面有两条宽宽的纹理带，外观看起来像软木，并点缀着细小的金色亮片。鞋子没有可见的扣合装置，直接套穿；棕褐色鞋床下方是深棕色、略微加厚的鞋底。

product: Vionic Women's Rest Floriana Toepost Sandal - Ladies Flip flops with Concealed Orthotic Support
description_en: A black thong sandal has a glossy, textured upper decorated with small brown and silver studs. It slips on, with a toe post and no buckle; the black sole is thick and slightly raised at the heel, with a textured tread underneath.
description_zh: 这是一只黑色夹趾凉鞋，鞋面带有光泽和纹理，并饰有棕色与银色小铆钉。凉鞋套脚穿着，以夹趾带固定，没有搭扣；黑色鞋底较厚，后跟略高，底面带有纹路。

product: New Balance Men's 481 V3 Trail Running Shoe
description_en: A dark brown and black trail-style shoe with orange accents, featuring a mesh and synthetic-looking upper with reinforced overlays. It fastens with orange-flecked black laces, and has a thick, rugged tan-and-black treaded sole with small orange details.
description_zh: 这是一只深棕色和黑色、带橙色点缀的越野风格鞋，鞋面看起来由网布和合成材料制成，并有加固覆层。鞋带为带橙色点缀的黑色鞋带；厚实的棕褐色与黑色鞋底带有粗犷纹路和少量橙色细节。

product: TENGTA Unisex Waterproof Garden Shoes Womens Rain Boots Mens Car Wash Footwear
description_en: A black slip-on garden shoe has a smooth-looking upper with a textured panel over the toe, plus a stretchy-looking collar edged in bright green. It has no visible laces or buckle, and the thick black sole has deep, irregular tread with a thin green stripe along the side.
description_zh: 这是一只黑色套穿式园艺鞋，鞋面看起来较光滑，鞋头处有一块带纹理的区域，弹性鞋口边缘饰有亮绿色。鞋面没有可见的鞋带或扣具；厚实的黑色鞋底带有深而不规则的纹路，侧边有一道细绿色条纹。

product: DREAM PAIRS Men's House Slippers Moccasin Indoor Outdoor Fuzzy Furry Loafers Suede Leather Warm Comfortable Shoes
description_en: This is a brown moccasin-style slip-on shoe with a suede-like upper and pale, fluffy lining visible at the opening. It has no fastener, and the brown rubber-like sole has a low profile with small ridges along the bottom.
description_zh: 这是一只棕色莫卡辛式套脚鞋，鞋面看起来像绒面材质，鞋口露出浅色蓬松的内衬。鞋上没有扣合装置，棕色鞋底较薄，底部带有细小纹路。

product: Clarks Women's Arla Elin Slide Sandal
description_en: A metallic taupe slide sandal has several wide straps across the foot, with hook-and-loop tabs for fastening. The upper looks like smooth synthetic material, and it has a thick, dark, molded sole with a ridged tread underneath.
description_zh: 这是一只金属光泽灰褐色的套脚凉鞋，鞋面有几条宽带，并以粘扣带固定。鞋面看起来是光滑的合成材料，配有厚实的深色模压鞋底，底部带有纹路。

product: Merrell Men's Moab Adventure MOC Hiking Shoe
description_en: A brown slip-on hiking shoe with a suede-like upper and darker mesh around the collar. It has no laces, and a thick, rugged black rubber sole with brown sections underneath.
description_zh: 这是一只棕色套脚式徒步鞋，鞋面看起来像麂皮，鞋口周围是较深色的网布。鞋面没有鞋带，底部是厚实、纹路粗犷的黑色橡胶鞋底，底面带有棕色部分。

product: Skechers Performance Women's Go Walk 3 Slip-On Walking Shoe
description_en: A gray slip-on walking shoe has a dark gray-and-black patterned knit upper, with a smooth gray panel across the toe. It has no laces or visible fastener, and a thick white sole with rounded segmented sections and a thin dark stripe.
description_zh: 这是一只灰色一脚蹬步行鞋，鞋面为深灰与黑色交织的针织图案，鞋头有一块光滑的灰色拼片。鞋上没有鞋带或可见的扣合件，厚白色鞋底带有圆弧分段和一道细深色条纹。

product: Skechers Sport Men's Energy Downforce Lace-Up Sneaker
description_en: A dark gray lace-up sneaker has a mixed-material upper, with smooth panels, stitched sections, and mesh-like fabric around the tongue and collar. Brown laces run through fabric loops, and a thick, sculpted light-gray midsole sits above a chunky black treaded outsole.
description_zh: 这是一只深灰色系带运动鞋，鞋面由多种材质组成，有光滑拼片、缝线区域，以及鞋舌和鞋口处类似网布的织物。棕色鞋带穿过织物鞋环，厚实的浅灰色中底下方是凹凸明显的黑色外底。

product: Dockers Proposal - Genuine Full-Grain Leather Slip-On Loafer Dress Shoes for Men Featuring All Motion Comfort Technology, EVA Sock Lining, and Durable Rubber Outsole
description_en: A black slip-on dress loafer with a smooth leather-looking upper, stitched seams, and a raised band across the instep. It has no laces or buckle, and a thick black sole with a low block heel.
description_zh: 这是一款黑色套脚正装乐福鞋，鞋面看起来光滑似皮革，带有缝线和横跨脚背的凸起饰带。鞋面没有鞋带或搭扣，配有厚实的黑色鞋底和低矮的方跟。

product: Saucony Women's ProGrid Integrity ST2 Walking Shoe
description_en: A white and light-gray walking shoe with a mostly synthetic-looking upper, perforated panels, and stitched overlays. It fastens with white laces, and has a thick, sculpted white midsole with gray and teal sections along the dark-gray outsole.
description_zh: 这是一双白色和浅灰色的步行鞋，鞋面看起来以合成材料为主，带有透气孔和拼接缝线。鞋带为白色；厚实、带有曲线造型的白色中底下方，可见灰色和蓝绿色的外底部分。

product: Cole Haan Men's Tucker Venetian Slip-On Loafer
description_en: A black slip-on loafer with a pebbled-looking upper and stitched apron-style toe. It has no visible laces or buckle, and a thick black sole with a ridged tread.
description_zh: 这是一只黑色套穿式乐福鞋，鞋面呈颗粒纹理，鞋头周围有缝线装饰。没有可见的鞋带或搭扣，配有厚实的黑色鞋底和带棱纹的鞋纹。

product: Skechers Sport Men's Stamina Nuovo Cutback Lace-Up Sneaker
description_en: A lace-up athletic sneaker with a dark navy and black upper, gray mesh panels, and white laces. The upper combines mesh with smooth-looking overlays, and the thick white sole has black tread and dark cutout details.
description_zh: 这是一款系带运动鞋，鞋面以深海军蓝和黑色为主，配有灰色网布和白色鞋带。鞋面由网布和光滑外观的拼接层组成，厚实的白色鞋底带有黑色纹路和深色镂空细节。

product: Skechers BOBS Women's Bobs Plush-Dream Doodle Ballet Flat
description_en: A gray slip-on ballet flat has a printed upper with dark animal silhouettes and bright pink accents, made of what looks like fabric. It has no visible fastener and a low, dark rubber-like sole.
description_zh: 这是一只灰色套穿式芭蕾平底鞋，布面上印有深色动物剪影和亮粉色点缀。看不到扣件，鞋底低矮，呈深色橡胶质感。

product: Tamarac by Slippers International Men's Scuffy Clog Slipper
description_en: A black slip-on clog slipper with a closed toe and an open back. The upper looks like soft, matte fabric with a small label at the side; a dark rubber-like sole has a ridged tread and stitched-looking edge detail.
description_zh: 这是一只黑色套脚式木屐拖鞋，鞋头包覆、后跟敞开。鞋面看起来是柔软的哑光织物，侧面有一小块标签；深色鞋底像橡胶，底面带有纹路，边缘有类似缝线的细节。

product: New Balance Men's 510v3 Trail Running Shoe
description_en: A dark navy trail-running shoe with a mesh-and-synthetic-looking upper, gray overlays, and bright lime accents. It fastens with black laces, and has a thick, sculpted gray sole with lime tread visible underneath.
description_zh: 这是一只深海军蓝色越野跑鞋，鞋面看起来由网布和合成材料拼成，带有灰色饰片和亮黄绿色点缀。鞋带为黑色，鞋底厚实且有立体纹路，灰色鞋底下方可见黄绿色外底。

product: Dansko Women's Pro XP Waterproof
description_en: A dark brown, closed-toe clog with a smooth, shiny leather-looking upper and a raised heel. It has no visible fastener, and the thick dark sole has a low heel and stitched-looking detailing around the edge.
description_zh: 这是一款深棕色包头木屐鞋，鞋面光滑有光泽，看起来像皮革，后跟略高。鞋面没有可见的扣合装置；深色厚鞋底带低跟，边缘有类似缝线的细节。

product: Skechers Women's Microburst One up Fashion Sneaker
description_en: A dark navy slip-on sneaker has a knitted-looking fabric upper and a low, rounded toe. It has no visible laces or straps, and a thick light-gray sole with a textured, ridged tread.
description_zh: 这是一只深藏青色的套穿式运动鞋，鞋面看起来像针织面料，鞋头低矮圆润。鞋面没有可见的鞋带或搭扣，配有厚实的浅灰色鞋底，底面纹路凸起。

product: Polar Women's Nylon Tall Winter Snow Boot
description_en: A tall white snow boot has a quilted-looking synthetic upper, a fluffy white collar, and white laces threaded through side loops and straps with snap buttons. Its thick white rubber sole has a thin black stripe and a ridged tread.
description_zh: 这是一只白色高筒雪地靴，鞋面看起来带有绗缝纹理，配有白色绒毛靴口；白色鞋带穿过侧面的鞋环和带按扣的搭带。厚白色橡胶鞋底带有一道细黑线，底部有凸纹。

product: Nike Women's Benassi Just Do It Sandal
description_en: A black open-toe slide sandal has a wide, smooth-looking synthetic strap across the foot, with no buckle or other fastening. Its black sole has a raised rim and a textured, dimpled footbed.
description_zh: 这是一只黑色露趾一字拖，鞋面是一条宽阔、表面平滑的合成材质搭带，没有扣件或其他固定装置。黑色鞋底边缘略高，鞋床带有凹凸纹理。

product: Skechers Sport Women's Breathe Easy Fortune Fashion Sneaker
description_en: A dark navy, low-cut sneaker has a fine-textured, sparkly-looking fabric upper with darker overlays and elastic laces across the top. It has a pull tab at the heel and a thick, dark rubber sole with molded ridges and tread.
description_zh: 这是一只深海军蓝色的低帮运动鞋，鞋面为细纹理、带闪光感的织物，并有颜色较深的拼接片，鞋面上横跨着弹力鞋带。鞋跟处有提环，厚实的深色橡胶鞋底带有模压纹路和防滑纹。

product: Merrell Men's Moab 2 Mid Waterproof Hiking Boot
description_en: A brown mid-height hiking boot with dark mesh panels and suede-like overlays, plus black protective edging around the toe. It fastens with orange-and-black laces through fabric loops and metal eyelets, and has a thick, rugged black sole with deep tread.
description_zh: 这是一只棕色中帮徒步靴，带有深色网布拼片、绒面质感的覆盖层，以及包住鞋头的黑色防护边。橙黑相间的鞋带穿过织物鞋环和金属鞋孔，搭配厚实、带深纹路的黑色鞋底。

product: Teva Men's Katavi 2
description_en: A dark brown and charcoal sport sandal with an open toe and heel. Its upper has textured fabric straps with brown edging and orange lettering, fastened by adjustable hook-and-loop straps. The thick dark rubber sole has a rugged, deeply treaded bottom.
description_zh: 这是一款深棕色和炭灰色的运动凉鞋，露趾且后跟敞开。鞋面由带纹理的织物鞋带构成，边缘为棕色，并饰有橙色字样；鞋带以可调节的粘扣带固定。厚实的深色橡胶鞋底带有粗犷、深刻的纹路。

product: Vibram Men's Five Fingers, KSO EVO Crosstraining
description_en: A black, low-cut five-toe shoe has a mesh-like upper with red laces and a small black toggle. Its thin black sole has bright red sections visible beneath the toes and along the edge.
description_zh: 这是一只黑色低帮分趾鞋，鞋面看起来像网布，配有红色鞋带和一个小黑色扣件。鞋底较薄，主体为黑色，脚趾下方和边缘可见亮红色部分。

product: Minnetonka Men's Double Bottom Fleece Slipper
description_en: A black moccasin-style slipper with a fuzzy, suede-like upper and a red-and-black plaid lining. It has a tan leather lace tied across the front, and a thick, flat tan sole with visible stitching around the edge.
description_zh: 这是一只黑色莫卡辛式拖鞋，鞋面看起来毛茸茸的，像麂皮，内衬为红黑格纹。鞋头系着一根棕褐色皮绳，鞋底厚而平，边缘可见缝线。
